hotel_name: The Lodge at Primland, Auberge Collection

claims.text: The Lodge at Primland sits on 12,000 private acres above the Dan River Gorge in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Virginia.

findings.quote: The Lodge at Prim land is a luxury Blue Ridge Mountains resort on 12,000 private acres above the Dan River Gorge in Virginia.

claims.text: The Lodge rooms and suites have deep soaking tubs, private balconies, sliding floor-to-ceiling windows and Frette sheets.

findings.quote: deep soaking tubs, impeccable views, private balconies, sliding floor-to-ceiling windows and Frette sheets

claims.text: Fairway Cottages sit along the golf course and have cathedral ceilings and living areas with Tennessee fieldstone fireplaces.

findings.quote: Located along the golf course with stunning jade and sapphire-hued mountain views, fairway accommodations offer hardwood floors, cathedral ceilings and cozy living areas with Tennessee fieldstone fireplaces.

claims.text: Eleven Rustic Mountain Homes at the Sporting Club have wraparound decks, outdoor hot tubs and stone fireplaces.

findings.quote: Tucked into infinitely private settings at the Sporting Club, 11 Rustic Mountain Homes
enjoying wraparound decks, outdoor hot tubs, stone fireplaces and rolling lawns

claims.text: The Highland Course is an 18-hole championship golf course set across the ridges and valleys of the Blue Ridge Mountains.

findings.quote: The Highland Course is Primland’s 18-hole championship golf course, set across the ridges and valleys of the Blue Ridge Mountains.

claims.text: The Primland Sporting Club offers sporting clays, archery and air rifle, with guides and instruction.

findings.quote: Guests can experience activities including sporting clays, archery and air rifle, with expert guides and instruction available for beginners and experienced participants alike.

claims.text: Stables Saloon serves a Southern supper family-style.

findings.quote: Enjoy a Southern supper menu featuring family-style favorites in a laid-back atmosphere
Served family-style

claims.text: Sage, Wellbeing by Auberge, is the resort's spa and wellbeing destination, inspired by the Blue Ridge Mountains.

findings.quote: is Primland’s spa and wellbeing destination, with with nature-based treatments
At The Lodge at Primland, wellbeing is inspired by the rhythms of nature and the Blue Ridge Mountains.

claims.text: The indoor heated swimming pool is chlorine-free.

findings.quote: The indoor heated swimming pool is chlorine-free

claims.text: The Tree Houses were designed in France by the treehouse architectural firm La Cabane Perchee and built of aromatic red cedar.

findings.quote: Designed in France by renowned treehouse architectural firm La Cabane Perchee – and built of aromatic red cedar

claims.text: The Schlumberger Wine Cellar in The Lodge is named for the sister property Domaines Schlumberger in Alsace, France.

findings.quote: Named for sister property – Domaines Schlumberger – in Alsace, France
Plan your private get-together or attend a tasting in our Schlumberger Wine Cellar, located in The Lodge.

claims.text: Stables Saloon is on the second floor of Primland's former horse stables, regularly hosts live bluegrass concerts and is part of the Crooked Road: Virginia's Heritage Music Trail.

findings.quote: Climb the stairs to the secluded second floor of Primland’s former horse stables
the rustic Stables Saloon regularly hosts live bluegrass music concerts and is part of the Crooked Road: Virginia’s Heritage Music Trail

claims.text: The resort has an on-property observatory, and Condé Nast Traveler describes nightly guided stargazing sessions there.

findings.quote: state-of-the-art Observatory
Additional on-site activities include nightly guided stargazing in the observatory

claims.text: The Junior Mountaineers Kids Club is for children ages 6-12 and includes pond-fishing, foraging, archery and horseback riding.

findings.quote: Kids ages 6-12 embark on a journey through nature-based experiences ranging from pond-fishing to foraging and archery to horseback riding.

claims.text: Accessing the Tree Houses requires a four-wheel drive vehicle, and complimentary shuttle services are available for guests without one.

findings.quote: Please note: Accessing the Tree Houses requires a four-wheel drive vehicle. For guests who do not have four-wheel drive, complimentary shuttle services are available.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler says guests who want to go off property would need a car of their own.

findings.quote: If you are interested in going off property, you’d definitely need a car of your own.

claims.text: Private airport transportation is available for a fee upon request.

findings.quote: private airport transportation is available for a fee upon request
